purpose: Teach: 輸出入/顛末/参与/受け手/撤収/マージン/例示/売り出し

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 輸出入手続の改善案を準備しましょう
lines.en: Let's prepare some improvement proposals for the export-import process.
lines.style: Crisp, forward-moving. Light emphasis on the action verb. Efficient tone — this is workable and moving. No hesitation, no performance.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。お得意様トラブルの顛末を共有します
lines.en: Yes. I'll share the details about what happened with the VIP client issue.
lines.style: Straightforward, responsive. Quick acknowledgment at the top. Matter-of-fact delivery on the follow-up. Reliable, no flourish.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 業界協会の参与会議に出席しましょう
lines.en: Let's make sure we attend the industry association's advisory meeting.
lines.style: Clear directive. Steady vocal weight. Slight emphasis on the attendance itself — this is important enough to name. Not rushed, not casual.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。広告は受け手目線で組みます
lines.en: Yes. I've structured the ad from the viewer's perspective.
lines.style: Confirmatory, confident but understated. Light tap of assurance on the method — he's thought about it. Efficient handoff of the update.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 展示会から早めに撤収しましょう
lines.en: Let's wrap up the exhibition earlier than planned.
lines.style: Decisive instruction. Clipped, no softening. The decision is made and communicated clearly. Efficient pace.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。お得意様向けマージン優遇を案内しました
lines.en: Yes. I've already announced the special margin terms for our VIP clients.
lines.style: Accomplished, quick. Light lift on the completion — already done. Professional, matter-of-fact. No need to elaborate.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: プレゼンには事例を例示で挿入しましょう
lines.en: Let's include case studies as examples in the presentation.
lines.style: Directive with subtle emphasis on the specificity. Case studies matter here. Calm authority — not loud, just clear about what's needed.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新商品の売り出しキャンペーンを企画中です
lines.en: Yes. I'm currently planning the launch campaign for the new product line.
lines.style: Engaged, forward-looking. Energy comes from momentum, not volume. The present-continuous tense carries the sense of active progress. Professional close.
